From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipe Thermometer: coverage gap remediation & stage hygiene

Hi Elena —

Following up from our demo last week. Finance at Redwood ran a quick coverage "thermometer" for ByteScale against our Q3 target and there are a few near-term items we want to align on that affect the forecast. I attached a small snapshot (Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx) with the current pipe-to-quota picture and the three opportunities we flagged as swing deals. High-level: 

- Current gross coverage: 1.7x (target 2.5x)
- Gap to quota: ~$420k (after weighting)
- Swing set (3 deals): combined upside ~$360k if each moves to commit in next 6 weeks

Can you confirm the procurement timing for ByteScale on the three OPS IDs in the sheet? Specific asks: 

1) Confirm expected PO / budget approval week for the largest deal (ByteScale Core).
2) Any external approvals blocking the legal/contract signature (security review, SOC details)?
3) If procurement slips, would a staged pilot + initial invoice in July be acceptable to keep revenue in Q3?

If you prefer, we can hop on a 15-min call later this week to go through the mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx

Marcus —

Thanks for the snapshot and the heads-up. We're in the middle of our quarterly budget review so timing is tighter than usual. Quick notes: 

- ByteScale Core (largest): procurement expects director sign-off by 06/30, legal review to follow week of 07/06.
- Analytics add-on (mid-size): internal pilot approval pushed to 07/20 (risk of slipping to Aug).
- Platform integration (small): procurement greenlighted but needs final security checklist (should clear next week).

I'm attaching a short PO timeline PDF from our finance team that shows the earliest/likely/worst-case dates. If you can provide a mutual action plan that stages the deliverables and payment milestones (pilot + ramp), that would help us accelerate director sign-off.

Elena
Elena Cruz

elena@bytescale.com | +1 650-555-2233

- Keep Analytics add-on at "Qualified" until pilot approval (25% weighting); plan a pilot MOU to capture revenue in Q3 if possible.
- Platform integration: update to "Contracting" and target E-sign by 2026-07-01.

2) open a DocuSign for the pilot MOU (link below).
